```yaml
# actionlint-disable dangerous-triggers
name: Flaky Monitor

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["CI"]
    types:
      - completed

jobs:
  flaky-monitor:
    if: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' && github.event.workflow_run.head_branch == 'main' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Download test artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-results
          path: ./artifacts

      - name: Run flaky monitor
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ ! -x ./scripts/flaky-monitor.sh ]; then
            echo "flaky-monitor script not found or not executable"
            exit 1
          fi
          ./scripts/flaky-monitor.sh ./artifacts

      - name: Upload flaky report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: flaky-report
          path: ./flaky-report
```
